name: io.github.wavyrai/rm-mcp
title: reMarkable MCP Server
description: Find, read, view and transcribe reMarkable notes; send PDFs to the tablet. Never deletes.

environmentVariables.name: REMARKABLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Run `uvx rm-mcp@latest setup` instead: it saves a token rm-mcp reads first. This variable is used only when that file is absent.

environmentVariables.name: REMARKABLE_ROOT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Show only this folder of the library, such as /Work.

environmentVariables.name: REMARKABLE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to refuse every write.
